read.thesis: Ally Q1 CY26 GAAP EPS $0.93 and Core ROTCE 11.1%, with auto originations up 13% to $11.5B and retail auto NCO down 15 bps to 1.97%; no capacity or pricing-discipline commentary, and the year-over-year gains are flattered by 2025 Credit Card and repositioning items.

triggers.label: Auto originations up 13% YoY
triggers.quote: originations of $11.5 billion, a 13% increase year over year despite lower industry sales

triggers.label: Retail auto NCO down 15 bps
triggers.quote: The retail auto net charge-off rate of 1.97% decreased 15 bps year over year.

red_flags.label: Provision up 276M YoY on CECL build
red_flags.quote: a CECL reserve build associated with asset growth in the quarter
